description:
A cross-platform music tagger powered by the MusicBrainz database.

MusicBrainz Picard is a cross-platform music file tagger.
Your music files don’t just contain music. They also contain “metadata”, consisting of “tags” which consist of a tag name or type and associated data, for example the album or track name, the name of the artist, the record label, the year of issue etc. Unless you rip the music files yourself with a very basic tool, your music files probably already contain some basic metadata, however there are literally hundreds of tags that can be applied to your music if you are interested.
Obviously, if you wanted to you could painstakingly research all this information for each album and track individually, and type the data into a tagging tool, but clearly it makes more sense in this internet connected age for one person to do this for each album and track, to upload that data to a shared database and then for the tagging tool to access that database and use the data to tag the music files. And that is what MusicBrainz Picard does.
MusicBrainz is the database, and Picard is the tool that tags the music files.
Bugfixes

- PICARD-2530 - Extremely high CPU usage and slow performance working on standalone recordings
- PICARD-3455 - Headers on Preferred Releases page not translated

- PICARD-3457 - High memory use and low performance when saving many files
- PICARD-3458 - Context menu key isn't always handled, and/or context menu doesn't appear where it should
- PICARD-3459 - Memory for "Other versions" in the release context menu not freed
- PICARD-3461 - Cover art composition when multiple albums are selected is replaced by placeholder
- PICARD-3463 - Setup wizard has cropped text on macOS
- PICARD-3464 - Metadata options page greys out on click after upgrading from Picard 2.13.3
- PICARD-3466 - Selecting a track shows an empty metadata panel after upgrading from Picard 2 when the naming script uses a missing plugin function
- PICARD-3468 - macOS dock shows different app icon when Picard is running
- PICARD-3473 - Input placeholder text hard to read in light theme
- PICARD-3474 - Can't unregister a hidden script variable from a plugin
Improvements
- PICARD-3472 - Cluster matching picks the wrong release when the correct one has a placeholder catalog number, or when a wrong-artist release shares the album title
